about_the_game:
Product Introduction:

Order or violence? Justice or truth? Do you choose to face fate and break free from shackles, or are you trapped in a cage and exhausted?

"FLAM EVAW "is a spin off sequel to the real-life suspense romance interactive film game" Detective, Please Protect My Secrets ". You will continue to take on the role of community detective Maple Kurosawa, continuing the story from the end of this game. With your powerful detective and hacker skills, you will join several female assistants with different styles to officially embark on the path of investigating against the Rainbow Criminal Organization.

Regarding this trial version:

This chapter is only a demo of the "FLAM EVAW" game, and only the "Qihang" chapter and some features are available. The official version will be launched in September, please stay tuned.

Order or violence? Justice or truth? Do you choose to face fate and break free from shackles, or are you trapped in a cage and exhausted? Chilan "is a spin off sequel to the real-life suspense romance interactive film game" Detective, Please Protect My Secrets ". You will continue to take on the role of community detective Maple Kurosawa, continuing the story from the end of this game. With your powerful detective and hacker skills, you will join several female assistants with different styles to officially embark on the path of investigating against the Rainbow Criminal Organization.

Unlike other video games, the definition of this chapter is DEMO, which is a story chapter specially created by the production team for the purpose of connecting the story and testing game technology. It is prioritized for players to experience for free and is not the prologue or first chapter of the story; Of course, this chapter will also appear in the official version. I hope everyone has a pleasant exploration.

Role Introduction：

In the demo, there is only one female character, and that is the beautiful assistant who has been accompanying you since the beginning of this game.

                                                                   Kitty

In "Detective, Please Keep My Secret", Kitty's limited screen time has always been a regret for many players; But in 'The Legend of Mir', this time Kitty will spend more time by your side, helping you find the truth together!

There are a total of four female characters in "The Legend of FLAM EVAW", and the other three will be introduced to everyone in the official version. Stay tuned!

Product Features：

1. The original team continues their adventure

As a spin off sequel to 'Detective, Please Keep My Secret', the production team will retain the original team! Authentic plot sequel! Familiar actors, more ups and downs in the plot, and unforgettable choices! Upgrade this first person adventure once again!

2. Gameplay upgrade hardcore reasoning

·The game has reached an epic level upgrade in gameplay! A brand new item exploration mode, clue card collection, character skill tree board (yes, you can operate your female companion to activate skills! There are also your exclusive skills!), and a super hardcore reasoning mode! Double the excitement of this adventure! All results depend on your reasoning!

·The plot tree will be upgraded again! Unique personal and peer investigation plot modes allow you to focus on your peers or newly acquainted female characters to explore their secrets! Or give up love and become a meticulous detective! Face the villain directly! Searching for the truth!

3. Powerful features and a brand new experience

·Male lead voice switch freely

In the game, we have prepared two versions of the male lead voice for players. You can choose the voice of Maple Kurosawa and switch seamlessly at any time, bringing players a different experience.

·Free choice of visual style

Similarly, we have also prepared two visual styles for players: 'Classic Movie Game' and 'Immersive Movie'. You can still freely switch and choose the listening effect you want.

·Two modes with different challenges

The "Chilan Express" adopts two difficulty modes: realistic mode and classic mode. You can choose the difficulty according to your preferences and embark on your own path of reasoning!

Follow us:

QQ Group ① Group: 182063329

We will regularly distribute welfare merchandise, organize everyone to vote, choose the storyline direction you want to continue, and choose your favorite character to return to the stage.

Adult Content Description:

Some of the plot contains implicit expressions related to sex, and there are also parts of violence, smoking, and drinking. Specific options need to be selected to trigger the relevant plot.
